title: Un pantalon, des bijoux, le livre ou la livre
summary: Let the French noun determine number and gender, including meaning-changing pairs.
objectives: Avoid importing English countability or plural forms into French.
Apply the seven common -ou plural exceptions.
Use articles to distinguish common nouns with different meanings by gender.

sources.label: Public A2 index: topic-coverage reference only

sections.title: French and English do not always count the same way
paragraphs: A noun's grammatical number belongs to French, not to its English translation. Un pantalon (m.) is one pair of trousers; un short (m.) one pair of shorts; un pyjama (m.) one set of pyjamas; un escalier (m.) a staircase or flight of stairs. Conversely, les vacances (f. plural) can mean one holiday, les cheveux (m. plural) someone's hair, des renseignements (m. plural) information, and des conseils (m. plural) advice.

Most nouns ending in -ou add s: un trou/des trous, un clou/des clous, un sou/des sous. Seven common exceptions add x: bijou/bijoux, caillou/cailloux, chou/choux, genou/genoux, hibou/hiboux, joujou/joujoux and pou/poux. These are masculine nouns; learn the whole set rather than extending x to every -ou noun.
points: Meanings: un bijou (m.) a jewel/piece of jewellery; un caillou (m.) a pebble; un chou (m.) a cabbage; un genou (m.) a knee; un hibou (m.) an owl; un joujou (m.) a toy (familiar); un pou (m.) a louse.
Nouns still control verb and adjective agreement: mon pantalon est propre, mes vacances sont finies. Une information is a valid countable French noun, unlike English an information.

examples.note: One garment is singular in French.
French vacances is plural in this meaning.

examples.french: Elle donne **des conseils** et **des renseignements** utiles.
examples.english: She gives useful advice and information.
examples.note: French allows these plural count nouns.

examples.french: Il a mal aux **genoux** ; des **cailloux** sont entrés dans ses chaussures.
examples.english: His knees hurt; pebbles got into his shoes.

mistakes.why: French pantalon is singular for one pair of trousers.

sections.title: The article can select a different meaning
paragraphs: Some nouns have the same spelling but different meanings with masculine and feminine articles. Learn the article together with the meaning, not as a decoration. Le livre (m.) is a book; la livre (f.) a pound, a unit of weight or currency. Le tour (m.) is a turn, trip around or trick; la tour (f.) a tower. Le manche (m.) is a handle; la manche (f.) a sleeve or a round of a game.

Le mode (m.) is a mode/method; la mode (f.) fashion. Le poste (m.) can mean a job position or device; la poste (f.) the postal service. Le voile (m.) is a veil; la voile (f.) a sail or sailing. Le poêle (m.) is a stove; la poêle (f.) a frying pan. Context helps, but an incorrect article can change the message rather than merely its agreement.
points: Other useful pairs: le moule (m.), a mould; la moule (f.), a mussel. Le mémoire (m.), a dissertation/report; la mémoire (f.), memory. These meanings need their own noun cards.

examples.french: Je lis **un livre** sur **la livre** britannique.
examples.english: I am reading a book about the British pound.
examples.note: The same spelling names different things.

examples.french: **Le manche** de la poêle est chaud ; **la manche** de ma veste est mouillée.
examples.english: The frying pan's handle is hot; my jacket's sleeve is wet.

examples.french: Il cherche **un poste** dans **la mode**, près de **la poste**.
examples.english: He is looking for a job in fashion, near the post office.

mistakes.avoid: Ces bijoux sont dans des boîtes pleines de cloux.
mistakes.prefer: Ces bijoux sont dans des boîtes pleines de clous.
mistakes.why: Bijou is an -oux exception; clou is not.

practice.prompt: Supply être in the present: Ce pantalon ___ neuf.
Give the plural of un bijou with des.
Supply le or la for a book: ___ livre est sur la table.
Supply le or la for a tower: ___ tour est haute.
Give the plural of un caillou with des.
Give the plural of un chou with des.
Give the plural of un hibou with des.
Give the plural of un joujou with des.
Give the plural of un pou with des.
Use the plural French noun conseil for the English uncountable advice: Merci pour vos ___.
Supply le or la for a handle: ___ manche du couteau est en bois.
Supply un or une for a job position: Elle cherche ___ poste.
Give the plural of un genou with des.
Give the plural of un trou with des.
Supply le or la for a frying pan: ___ poêle est dans le placard.
practice.explanation: The frying pan is feminine; the stove is masculine.

practice.prompt: Supply être in the present: Mes vacances ___ courtes.
practice.explanation: Vacances is plural even for one holiday.

practice.prompt: Supply le or la for a boat's sail: ___ voile est déchirée.
practice.explanation: The sail is feminine; a veil is masculine.

practice.prompt: Supply le or la for a method or setting: ___ mode automatique fonctionne.

production_task.prompt: Describe items to pack or check before a trip. Include a French singular garment, a plural that differs from English and a meaning-changing noun with a clear article.
production_task.model_answer: Mon pantalon est propre, mais mes chaussures sont encore mouillées. J'ai besoin de renseignements sur le trajet. Je prends un livre pour le train et je laisse mes bijoux à la maison.
production_task.translation: My trousers are clean, but my shoes are still wet. I need information about the journey. I am taking a book for the train and leaving my jewellery at home.
rubric: Use French rather than English grammatical number.
Remember the -oux exceptions without overapplying them.
Use the article that matches the intended meaning.
